texts.W01: Experienced vehicle mechanic. Skills: Engine Repair, Automotive Diagnostics, Brake Systems. Overhauls petrol and diesel engines, reads fault codes with a scanner, replaces brake pads and discs. Garage in Addis Ababa.

texts.W05: Welder. Skills: Welding. Makes gates and window frames with arc welding.
texts.W06: Panel beater. Skills: Panel Beating, Welding. Repairs dents and body damage on cars, sprays and finishes panels, some welding.

texts.W36: Truck driver. Skills: Heavy Vehicle Driving. Heavy vehicle driver with a clean record, local and regional deliveries.
